title: Smoky Chicken with Spanish Roast Vegetables
description: A fusion of Chinese and Spanish flavors in this smoky chicken dish with roasted vegetables.
instructions: Season the chicken with smoky paprika, spanish smoked salt, and olive oil.
In a separate bowl, toss the carrots, red bell pepper, and potatoes with olive oil and roast garlic.
Place the chicken and vegetables on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast in the preheated oven for 25 minutes.
After 25 minutes, increase the oven temperature to broil and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
During the last 2 minutes of cooking, brush the chicken with soy sauce.
Check the chicken's internal temperature to ensure it reaches 165°F (74°C).
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Garnish with chopped green onions and sesame seeds, if desired.
